T Mobile Us (TMUS) Position Has Upped by Swarthmore Group Inc; Twenty First Centy Fox (FOXA) Stock Price Rose While Srs Investment Management Upped Its Position
May 17, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Karthik Sarma increased its stake in Twenty First Centy Fox Inc (FOXA) by 27.27% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Srs Investment Management Llc bought 2.46M shares as the company’s stock rose 3.52% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Karthik Sarma held 11.46M shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $395.71 million, up from 9.00M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Srs Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Twenty First Centy Fox Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $69.81 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.73% or $0.28 during the last trading session, reaching $37.88. About 3.09 million shares traded. Twenty-First Century Fox, Inc. (NASDAQ:FOXA) has risen 14.36% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.81% the S&P500.
Swarthmore Group Inc increased its stake in T Mobile Us Inc (TMUS) by 46.6% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Swarthmore Group Inc bought 47,475 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.16% with the market. The institutional investor held 149,350 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.49 million, up from 101,875 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Swarthmore Group Inc who had been investing in T Mobile Us Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $47.91B market cap company. The stock increased 0.07% or $0.04 during the last trading session, reaching $56.57. About 1.09M shares traded. T-Mobile US, Inc. (NYSE:TMUS) has declined 6.04% since May 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.59% the S&P500.
Srs Investment Management Llc, which manages about $3.65 billion and $3.85 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Microsoft Corp (NASDAQ:MSFT) by 478,168 shares to 160,239 shares, valued at $13.71M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Adobe Sys Inc (NASDAQ:ADBE) by 93,175 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 124,881 shares, and cut its stake in Zillow Group Inc.
